title: agent-hook shim protocol v1: the request
description: What a shim (an extension that runs inside a harness, such as Pi) writes on the agent-hook binary's stdin for one hook call: one JSON object and nothing else. The binary checks every request against this schema, and checks that its harness and event are the binary's own arguments. A request that fails is a broken exchange: before the tool, every hook blocks (rule shim.broken); after it, nothing runs.

harness.description: The harness, as the binary's first argument names it.

event.description: pre: before the tool runs; post: after it ran.

tool.description: The harness's own name for the tool.

input.description: The tool's input, as the harness hands it to its extensions.

cwd.description: The absolute directory the harness resolves the tool's paths against. The shim runs the binary in it.

ok.description: post only: whether the tool call succeeded.

context.description: What else the harness tells about the call, such as OpenCode's agent. No hook reads it yet.
